deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is a draft of §17 of Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857), where the p-fold theta series is introduced for later use in the Jacobi inversion problem. The next page drafts the zero-counting argument of §22, which leads to e_mu = sum_nu alpha_mu^(nu) + k_mu.

(1) Purpose (opening lines). For the further study of integrals of algebraic differentials, Riemann introduces a p-fold infinite series. The logarithm of its general term is an integral polynomial of degree 2 in the summation indices ('Stellenzeiger'):
theta(v_1,...,v_p) = sum_{m in Z^p} exp( sum_{mu,mu'} a_{mu,mu'} m_mu m_mu' + 2 sum_mu v_mu m_mu ).
The coefficients satisfy a_{nu,nu'} = a_{nu',nu} (symmetric p x p matrix A). Written out, the log of the general term is a_{11} m_1^2 + 2 a_{12} m_1 m_2 + a_{22} m_2^2 + ... + a_{pp} m_p^2 + 2 v_1 m_1 + ... + 2 v_p m_p. The constant term is 0. The inner (exponent) sum runs over mu, mu'; the outer sums run over m_1,...,m_p. This is the modern theta function with Riemann's normalisation: the exponent is 'a' rather than pi i tau, and there is a factor 2 in front of v. Modern form: theta(z|tau) with A = pi i tau and v = pi i z.

(2) Convergence. The series converges when the real part of the quadratic form Q(m) = sum a_{mu mu'} m_mu m_mu' is 'wesentlich negativ', i.e. Re A is negative definite. The corrected passage spells this out as becoming infinitely negative for infinitely growing m, i.e. transformable into a sum of p negative squares of independent real linear forms.
[My filling: then |general term| <= exp(-c|m|^2 + C|m|) locally uniformly in v, so theta is an entire function of v.]

(3) Quasi-periodicity. theta is regarded as a function of the p variables v.
(a) For mu = 1..p: theta(..., v_mu + pi i, ...) = theta, because exp(2 pi i m_mu) = 1.
(b) theta(v_1 + a_{1,mu}, ..., v_p + a_{p,mu}) = exp(-2 v_mu - a_{mu,mu}) theta(v).
[My verification of (b): after the shift, the exponent is Q(m) + 2 sum_nu v_nu m_nu + 2 sum_nu a_{nu mu} m_nu. Put m = n - e_mu. By symmetry of A, Q(n - e_mu) = Q(n) - 2 sum_nu a_{mu nu} n_nu + a_{mu mu}. The exponent then becomes Q(n) + 2 sum v_nu n_nu - 2 v_mu - a_{mu mu}. Summing over n in Z^p gives the factor.]
Correspondingly, the scattered marginal phrases say log theta changes only by an integer multiple of 2 pi i under (a). Under (b) it changes by -(2 v_mu + a_{mu,mu}), mod 2 pi i.

The page contains a first formulation (crossed out), a restart ('Es seien in diesen Reihen ...'), an empty placeholder 'theta(v_1,...,v_p) = ( )', and then the final two functional equations. These agree exactly with the printed §17.
errors: No mathematical errors: both functional equations, theta(v_mu + pi i) = theta and theta(v + a_{.,mu}) = exp(-2v_mu - a_{mu,mu}) theta, are correct for the stated series.

The marginal statement about the increment of log theta ('Zuwachs um a_{mu,mu} ... m_mu 2 pi i') is garbled and partially struck. As literally transcribed it is not a correct formula; the intended statement is the increment -(2 v_mu + a_{mu,mu}) mod 2 pi i.
The convergence condition is stated without proof (routine; negative definiteness of Re A is sufficient).

results.what: Definition of the p-variable theta series with symmetric coefficient matrix a_{mu,mu'} and linear term 2 sum v_mu m_mu
results.modern_name: Riemann theta function theta(z, tau) of genus p (Siegel-type period matrix)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann 1857 (Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen §17); building on Jacobi's one-variable theta and Rosenhain/Göpel for p=2

results.what: Convergence iff Re of the quadratic form is negative definite
results.modern_name: Convergence condition Im tau > 0 (Siegel upper half-space)

results.what: Quasi-periodicity: theta(v + pi i e_mu) = theta(v), theta(v + A e_mu) = exp(-2v_mu - a_mumu) theta(v)
results.modern_name: Functional equations / quasi-periodicity of the Riemann theta function

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working draft of the theta-function definition and quasi-periodicity relations exactly as printed in Riemann's 1857 paper on Abelian functions (§17). The adjacent pages draft the published zero-counting/inversion argument (§22). Nothing goes beyond the published text.

transcription_corrections: 'Für die ferneren Untersuchungen einer Integrales algebraischer Differentialien' should read 'Für die ferneren Untersuchungen über Integrale algebraischer Differentialien' (the printed text has 'Integrale').

'p ungeraden Quadrate' is almost certainly 'p negativen Quadraten' (the printed §17 asks that the real part be representable as a sum of p negative squares of independent real linear functions of the m). The struck 'Linearen' belongs to this phrase.

The struck sentence about log theta should be read as: under simultaneous change of v_1..v_p by a_{1,mu}..a_{p,mu}, log theta changes by -(2v_mu + a_{mu,mu}) (up to multiples of 2 pi i); under v_mu -> v_mu + pi i it changes only by multiples of 2 pi i.
The final formula is correctly theta(v_1+a_{1,mu}, ..., v_p+a_{p,mu}) = e^{-2v_mu - a_{mu,mu}} theta, and the line above it is theta(v_1, ..., v_mu + pi i, ..., v_p) = theta.
